name: @xo/ai-core
description: The AI Capability Layer — the sole interface between the compiler (and anything else) and AI providers. Exposes typed semantic capabilities (extractEntities, extractKnowledge, ...), never provider-specific APIs. Routes, retries, falls back, caches, rate-limits, circuit-breaks, and cost-accounts across pluggable providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Azure OpenAI, Ollama, or a deterministic replay/test provider) without callers ever depending on a specific one.
